name: Human flag
description: A sideways hold on a vertical pole with the body level, pulling with the top arm and pushing with the bottom one. Holds are trained on both sides.

steps.label: Side plank
steps.cue: Per side; hips high and body in one line.

steps.label: Clutch flag
steps.cue: Per side; wedge the elbow firmly into your hip.

steps.label: Vertical flag
steps.cue: Per side; pull with the top arm, push with the bottom arm.

steps.label: Tuck flag
steps.cue: Per side; face sideways, not at the floor or sky.

steps.label: Straddle flag
steps.cue: Per side; keep the bottom arm locked as the legs open.

steps.label: Full human flag
steps.cue: Per side; legs together and level with your shoulders.
